title: Asymptotics of superfluid Bjorken flow
summary: We consider the dynamics of an expanding superfluid modeled by Mueller-Israel-Stewart theory coupled to a complex scalar field with a $U(1)$ symmetry that is spontaneously broken. This is a manageable theoretical setting for explorations of the chiral phase transition of expanding quark-gluon plasma. We study the late proper-time behavior of Bjorken flow in this physical system and find that asymptotic solutions can be expressed as a transseries of a novel form, which contains factors like $τ^{-a\ln τ}$.
